results.title: AMMA
results.overview: In the days before meeting his long distance girlfriend for the first time, Dev attempts to get his overbearing mom to leave the apartment.

results.title: About the Process
results.overview: What is art all about? Faced with losing their sponsorship, three 'passionate artists' must go to great lengths - and to the park - to stand up for the rights of a blank canvas.

results.title: I Don’t Have the Codes
results.original_title: J'ai pas les codes : Les aventures inattendues du boulanger de Besançon
results.overview: This is the story of an ordinary man transformed by history. A simple baker from Besançon who became a political symbol of resistance. That of a France that knows how much it needs others to grow. Of working classes rejecting the siren calls of populism. He says: "I was nothing and I became a monster" to express the vertigo of his transformation. And so the baker entered politics, visited the United States in the footsteps of Martin Luther King, brought aid to the Ukrainians, and ran for legislative elections. Fearless. Fighting with all his heart. It is this inspiring, touching, and funny human epic that Pedro da Fonseca's camera followed closely, capturing his doubts, his hesitations, and his emotions.

results.title: León de Perú
results.overview: A documentary by vatican media about Robert Francis Prevost’s years of missionary work in the Latin American country. The film travels across Peru to Chiclayo, Chulucanas, Callao, Lima, and Trujillo to explore the life of the Augustinian Pontiff through the voices and testimonies of those who knew him, worked alongside him, or received his support as a missionary and shepherd.

results.title: Frankenstein: Legacy
results.overview: Frankenstein’s secrets did not die with him. As graves are torn up and patience disappear from asylum, William Browning sets out to find who stole his father’s body - and finds horrors close to home as his mother descends into madness.

results.title: Grinners
results.overview: Marley is a moderately successful horror cooking show host. Her life gets flipped upside down when she crosses paths with the voyeuristic possum mask. Marley has to survive the night as she is hunted down through the eyes of a possum.

results.title: Follow Aunty La
results.overview: Introducing #FOLLOWAUNTYLA – the title chosen by YOU, our amazing online community! Get ready to laugh, cry, and cheer as Aunty embarks on her journey to become the next online sensation.

results.title: WEB CORP.
results.overview: Web Corp. follows the inescapable cycle of a worker fly trapped in a systemic web spun by a boss spider. Crafted through traditional stop-motion, the film clashes the organic, vulnerable texture of papier-mâché against the harsh, cold authority of steel wires, transforming capitalist exploitation into both a thematic and physical allegory.

results.title: Wende: Vrijplaats
results.overview: Registration of the live concert by the Dutch singer Wende Snijders. Back to her musical core and an ode to playfulness, that is what singer and musician Wende wanted. In October 2024, her concert series Vrijplaats ('Free space') started in Carré, which brought her back to basics: two pianos, Wende's voice, pianist Nils Davidse and a surprising guest artist every evening. Now there is the live recording of her show with guests: Merol, Froukje and Sef.

results.title: FAMELESS
results.overview: "Do you desire to be seen?" Is the question Iggy must answer when coming face to face with an entity offering him the success he's dreamt of, but at a cost.

results.title: A Weekend Fiasco
results.overview: A Weekend Fiasco is a 2025 Nollywood romantic comedy-drama directed by Samuel Olatunji and produced by Damilola Osikoya under Switch Visuals, exploring the hilarious and chaotic consequences of a married couple secretly booking the same luxury beach resort for separate affairs.

results.title: My Magnolia
results.overview: After her husband’s death, Betsy deals with her grief through revisiting her own past. As the world around her struggles to understand her sudden and bold transformation, Betsy's story unfolds as a tender portrait of grief on one's own terms.

results.title: (не)Документальный фильм про осень
results.overview: Every autumn Timofey faces an irresistible melancholy. To overcome this feeling, he decides to make a documentary about autumn, but his shooting is disrupted by a girl who accidentally falls in love with the would-be documentary filmmaker.

results.title: They're in the Water
results.overview: After a nearby nuclear power plant goes dark, two fishermen must interrogate a visitor's true intentions before something worse gets inside.

results.title: Good Valley Stories
results.overview: In a peripheral neighbourhood, where the rural and urban worlds meet, the houses of the first migrants who arrived after the post-war period coexist with the new blocks of the dormitory city, where the latest wave of migration is concentrated. This humble corner is now an authentic global village. Good Valley Stories is a sum of constructs, of social, generational and identity, urban and ecological conflicts, but it is also a calm and humanistic look at today’s world.

results.title: Same, Again
results.overview: A theater group made up of various actresses and a male director are rehearsing a play when several cases of invisible abuse and homophobia begin to occur. The women begin to talk to each other and discover that they all have a painful story to tell.

results.title: Only God Knows Everything
results.overview: Do-woon, orphaned and raised by a priest, is ordained as a priest. In the confessional, he hears that his mother was murdered and an evil group reveals itself.

results.title: Coka Chicas
results.overview: When Sarah and her best friends Jessica and Chanel arrive at a dreamy Caribbean resort from their Parisian suburb, their goal is not to sip mojitos and dance the bachata. The three 25-year-olds are in fact “coka chicas”, drug mules, hoping to make their dream of opening a nail bar come true through a single drug smuggling hustle. Everything seems to be going to plan until Jessica is stopped by the police while they are boarding the plane back to France. The circumstances of her arrest are suspicious and when Sarah and Chanel start looking for her, she is not to be found at any police station or hospital. Bound by the sacred bonds of friendship the girls decide to stay and find Jessica, far from imagining the magnitude of the secrets they are about to uncover and the danger that will be unleashed…

results.title: Heritage Minutes: Anne Innis Dagg
results.overview: In 1956, Dr. Anne Innis Dagg became the first Western researcher to study any mammal in the wild in Africa. She is still known as one of the foremost experts on giraffes.
